title: A beautiful visit
text: The modernist house par excellence. Recommended by the guide. Everyone stops at Casa Batlló, but Gaudí worked on this house at the height of his expression as an architect. Furthermore, the roof can also be visited. The price of the visit is lower and the line is almost non-existent. I highly recommend it
author: 861giovannil

title: Casa milla
text:
Casa Milà, also known as La Pedrera, is one of Antoni Gaudí’s most iconic secular works  a residential building that feels more like a living sculpture than a block of flats. Recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, it stands as Gaudí’s final residential masterpiece, blending innovation, functionality, and artistic expression in a way that still feels ahead of its time.
Don’t skip the rooftop it’s the most magical part of the experience.
author: armandojrp2023

title: A masterpiece of architecture and art!
text:
La Pedrera (Casa Milà) is pure Gaudí's genius.
We booked the sunrise guided tour, and it was excellent; the guide was very knowledgeable and she explained to us how Gaudí designed every detail, from the flowing stone facade to the attic space used for laundry. 
One of the highlights, without question, is the rooftop. Walking among the surreal warrior chimneys while taking in 360-degree views of Barcelona and the mountains was unforgettable. 
The period apartment recreation on the floor below adds wonderful context about how upper-class families lived when the building was new. We learned a few
author: CuriousTraveler007

title: La Pedrera Sunrise Tour with uninterrupted views
text: Definitely worth waking up early for! We were the first visitors on to the roof of La Pedrera and had the place to ourselves and uninterrupted views of Gaudí’s Barcelona! Brilliant and very knowledgeable guide. Excellent experience made even better by the lack of crowds. Highly recommend the sunrise tour.

title: Appreciated
text: Gemma was knowledgable and patient. There was a mix up between trip advisor and Casa Mila team but Gemma made sure we could take the tour and sort it out afterwards.
author: travelswsister

title: Early Morning Access is Refreshingly Quiet
text: I highly recommend the early morning access tour! Unlike the rest of the attractions we visited in Barcelona, we actually have photos of La Pedrera without tons of people blocking our view. We had a real person guiding the small-group tour (rather than a recorded audio-tour), so were able to ask questions and pause for pictures. It's not really a "sunrise" tour, but maybe thats for the best. If you're interested in Gaudi architecture, then this is a MUST!
author: dfries10

title: This was the perfect way...
text: This was the perfect way to experience Casa Mila before the crowds arrived. The guide was extremely knowledgeable and personable, and the views of the city and Sagrada Familia from the roof were a welcome addition!
